key.name: dark-full-screen
key.description: If true the bar transparency will be reverted to original state when a window is touching the bar, false and the bar remains transparent at all time

key.name: disable-text-shadow
key.description: If true, text shadows will be disabled in the top bar. If false (default), text will have shadows to improve readability on transparent backgrounds.

key.name: auto-transparency
key.description: When true, the top bar opacity is measured from the wallpaper behind the panel so panel text keeps at least 4.5:1 contrast, instead of using the fixed opacity slider. Falls back to the slider if the wallpaper cannot be read.

key.name: auto-min-transparency
key.description: Auto mode never goes below this, so the bar keeps some presence over very dark wallpapers.

key.name: auto-max-transparency
key.description: Auto mode never goes above this, so the bar stays translucent even over a white wallpaper.

key.name: auto-last-opacity
key.description: Internal. Remembers the last opacity auto mode computed so the panel can paint at roughly the right value at login instead of visibly cross-fading from the manual value once the async wallpaper measurement lands. -1 means "not measured yet".
